item.title: Gov. Ivey funds program to help inmates with addiction
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala. (WDHN) -- Gov. Ivey announced Monday she has awarded a $598,000 grant to fund a program that helps inmates overcome drug addiction. The program will be implemented in eight Alabama prisons and will include a six-month program focused on ending addiction followed by a 12-months of group sessions to encourage long-term change. item.title: Video shows Hillary Clinton erupt at GOP over unauthorized Boebert photo during Epstein deposition
item.description: Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton threatened to walk out of a deposition after Rep. Lauren Boebert (R-Colo.) shared a picture of her during testimony to the House Oversight Committee for their investigation into Jeffrey Epstein.
